store.name: Viki Agent Store
store.tagline: Agent skills & plugins, ready to install.
store.description: A curated marketplace of portable agent plugins — each a self-contained bundle of skills that teach your AI coding agent to design interfaces, build native macOS apps, and produce polished launch videos.
store.author: Vignesh Ramamoorthy

design.name: Design
design.tagline: Design systems, motion, dark themes & interactive 3D UI.
design.author: LottieFiles · Design System
highlights: Design tokens: colors, typography, spacing & radius
Components: buttons, cards, modals, sidebars, tabs
Motion: timing, easing & choreography tables
Disney animation principles adapted for UI

skillDescriptions.clean-ux: Visual design language for all UI output. Every component, layout, and page should follow the design specs in the module files — tokens, typography, buttons, cards, accordions, sidebars, modals, and more.
skillDescriptions.motion-ux: Applies motion design principles to create emotionally-driven, technically sound animations. Provides timing, easing, choreography, and Disney animation principles adapted for UI. Works with CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie, or Spring.
skillDescriptions.minimal-ux: Light and dark editorial/agency UI with GSAP/Lenis motion, 3D coverflow galleries, and click-to-open detail panels.

notch-companion-app.name: Notch Companion App
notch-companion-app.tagline: Build native macOS apps that live under the MacBook notch.
notch-companion-app.author: NotchPaw
highlights: Build without Xcode using SwiftPM + a hand-assembled .app
Transparent, click-through overlay pinned under the notch
0%-idle-CPU animation loop with spring / Verlet physics
Global mouse monitors, context menus & DMG distribution

skillDescriptions.notch-companion-app: End-to-end playbook for lightweight macOS notch companion apps: transparent overlay over the notch, cursor-reactive physics animation, global mouse monitoring, code-drawn art and icons, headless testing, and DMG/GitHub distribution.

product-launch.name: Product Launch
product-launch.tagline: Turn a raw demo recording into a polished launch video.
product-launch.author: product-launch skill
highlights: Probes footage & tightens dead air automatically
Branded intro, synced captions, logo bug & outro CTA
Original synthesized music bed + UI sound effects
Cross-platform ffmpeg + Python, optional Swift fast path

skillDescriptions.product-launch: Assembles the best demo moments and layers on a branded intro, synced feature captions, transitions, a logo bug, an outro CTA, an end-card, plus a synthesized music bed and UI SFX — rendered with a cross-platform ffmpeg + Python engine.

apple-dev.name: Apple Dev
apple-dev.tagline: A comprehensive guide and skills for Apple and iOS app development.
apple-dev.author: Vignesh Ramamoorthy
highlights: Architecture & Data flow
App Store listing & submissions
In-App Purchases & Payment integration
Realtime widgets & transparency

skillDescriptions.app-store-listing: Guide for App Store Connect metadata and ASO — what Apple indexes, keyword budgeting, why competitor names are a 2.3.7 rejection, categories, pricing and featuring nominations.
skillDescriptions.app-store-release: Guide for App Store release management, phased releases, App Review guidelines, version bumps, fastlane, and TestFlight distribution.
skillDescriptions.app-store-submission: Guide for App Store submission — privacy questionnaires, export compliance, age ratings, demo accounts, per-platform review notes, and the 2.1 / 2.1(b) rejection playbooks.
skillDescriptions.architecture: Guide for iOS app architecture, Target layout, WidgetKit extensions, App Groups, Xcode project structure, shared code, and data flow.
skillDescriptions.build-and-run: Guide for xcodebuild, CLI simulator launching, scheme configurations, UDID targeting, provisioning profiles, code signing, and CLI testing.
skillDescriptions.clock-faces: Guide for SwiftUI continuous animation, clock widgets, dense timelines, TimelineProvider, rotating hands, CADisplayLink, and rendering ticks.
skillDescriptions.conventions: Guide for iOS Swift coding conventions, SwiftUI style, async/await usage, unowned/weak self, explicit types, trailing closures, and project rules.
skillDescriptions.feedback: Guide for implementing an in-app feedback and bug reporting loop without authenticated SDKs. Triggers on keywords like feedback, report an issue, contact us, Firebase REST, unauthenticated Firestore, URLSession.
skillDescriptions.in-app-purchases: Guide for In-App Purchases (Apple IAP / StoreKit 2) and payment integration. Triggers on keywords like IAP, StoreKit, subscription, paywall, non-consumable, revenue, restore purchases.
skillDescriptions.ios-agent-guide: Master index for iOS development rules, invariants, App Groups, WidgetKit limits, App Store constraints, and agent troubleshooting playbook.
skillDescriptions.macos-app: Shipping a Mac target: window lifecycle, the Window menu, Dock reopen, and the Guideline 4 rejection for a closed window that cannot be reopened.
skillDescriptions.qa-and-reviews: Guide for QA testing, app reviews, and multi-agent code audits. Triggers on keywords like QA, review, audit, functional test, bug hunt, and multi-agent.
skillDescriptions.realtime-widgets: Guide for real-time widgets, live activities, Dynamic Island, push to wake, background timeline refreshes, and high-frequency WidgetKit updates.
skillDescriptions.simulator-automation: Guide for xcrun simctl, simulator automation, UI testing, automated screenshot capture, device pairing, and headless iOS testing.
skillDescriptions.store-screenshots: Guide for generating App Store screenshots — script-driven frames, squircle device bezels, composing for the search thumbnail, and the marketing-honesty rules.
skillDescriptions.telemetry: Guide for Firebase Analytics (GA4), custom events, user properties, session tracking, crashlytics, and privacy-preserving telemetry without PII.
skillDescriptions.theming: Guide for SwiftUI theming, dark mode, color schemes, dynamic colors, asset catalogs, typography, branding, and style-aware widget designs.
skillDescriptions.transparency: Guide for iOS transparent widgets, background baking, wallpaper cropping, host transparency hacks, coordinate math, and blending UI components.
skillDescriptions.weatherkit: Guide for Apple WeatherKit integration, App Services provisioning, WeatherService APIs, CoreLocation, attribution requirements, and data caching.

file-organise.name: File Organise
file-organise.tagline: Clean up messy file collections — starting with music.
file-organise.author: Copilot Research
highlights: Repair titles, albums, artists, genres & years at scale
Strip piracy-site spam from names, tags & embedded art
Acoustic fingerprinting to identify untagged files
Bit-error-rate de-duplication that preserves alternate versions

skillDescriptions.songs: Repairs and organises messy music libraries at scale — filenames, metadata, folder structure, album art and duplicates. Uses Chromaprint + AcoustID fingerprinting to identify untagged files and find duplicates name matching cannot see.

hosting.name: Hosting
hosting.tagline: Ship a site to Vercel and wire up a custom domain.
hosting.author: Copilot Research
highlights: One-command production deploys to Vercel
Custom domain linking with registrar DNS steps
Initialises vercel.json for the detected framework
Handles token auth without leaking secrets

google-dev.name: Google Dev
google-dev.tagline: Get Google Sign-In and OAuth scopes through Google's verification review.
google-dev.author: Vignesh Ramamoorthy
highlights: Scope tiers, and when a CASA security assessment applies
The privacy-policy disclosures reviewers actually look for
Demo videos that pass, and the ffmpeg traps that ruin them
Reply templates for a verification rejection

skillDescriptions.google-oauth-verification: Submit for Google Sign-In / OAuth access and survive the review.

azure.name: Azure — Skill as Compute
azure.tagline: Rents an Azure VM for the heavy part of a job, then destroys it.
azure.author: Vignesh Ramamoorthy
highlights: One call: offload — create, upload, run, download, destroy
Sizes the machine to a monthly budget (default ₹10,000, shown in USD)
Live Azure retail pricing; steps down to a smaller VM rather than overspend
Three independent ways the VM dies, including a watchdog that deletes it if your laptop does not
Installs and signs in to the Azure CLI by itself; detects Spot and GPU restrictions before deploying

skillDescriptions.compute: The way any other skill borrows compute. Hands a compute-intense task to a temporary Azure VM sized to fit your budget, runs it there, brings the results back, and deletes the whole resource group.
